units.title: Build the portable ecosystem feedback transport
units.objective: Implement one strict append-only feedback contract and CLI that records, lists, reports, and dispositions evidence-backed policy, skill, instruction, tool, project, and general feedback without changing policy.

included: Portable record, list, report, and disposition CLI
Append-only JSONL validation and corruption detection
excluded: Project Meta legacy register migration or projection
Automatic policy, skill, instruction, or project changes

outputs: Validated portable ecosystem feedback Python contract

acceptance.criterion: All six scope kinds record through one strict command, while general feedback requires no fabricated scope identity.
acceptance.negative_control: Missing scoped identity, fabricated general identity, empty evidence, or an unknown field fails before append.

acceptance.criterion: Append, list, report, and disposition preserve original records and step down to stable feedback IDs.
acceptance.negative_control: Malformed JSONL, duplicate IDs, unknown dispositions, and conflicting terminal dispositions fail loud.

acceptance.criterion: The default stream stores only supplied semantic fields and evidence references; it never reads evidence contents or mutates policy.
acceptance.negative_control: A missing evidence file remains a valid reference and is never opened by the transport.

units.title: Integrate Project Meta routing and projections
units.objective: Make Project Meta consume the accepted portable feedback contract, retain explicit compatibility with policy and skill Markdown registers, and expose open feedback for evidence-backed triage.

included: Project Meta command adapter to the accepted portable transport
Open feedback summary with stable-ID step-down

outputs: Policy and skill feedback compatibility views

dependencies.rationale: Project Meta must consume one accepted portable contract rather than defining a competing schema.

conflict_surfaces.target: Makefile, feedback adapters/tests, policy_friction.md and skill_feedback.md compatibility documentation

acceptance.criterion: Project Meta routes all feedback kinds through the accepted contract and preserves legacy policy and skill registers as explicit compatibility surfaces.
acceptance.negative_control: A Project Meta-specific feedback schema or silent deletion of a legacy record fails review and tests.

acceptance.criterion: The triage report separates open and dispositioned entries by scope and steps down to exact stable IDs.
acceptance.negative_control: An unowned general entry remains visible and is not forced into a policy or skill projection.

units.title: Deliver universal routing and prove the loop
units.objective: Add one concise universal feedback-routing rule to the canonical workspace instruction and prove policy, skill, and general records traverse the installed command into Project Meta triage without per-artifact boilerplate.

included: One policy, one skill, and one general end-to-end probe
First real workflow-friction record and disposition
excluded: Adding generic feedback sections to every policy, skill, or project instruction
Automatic feedback triage or policy mutation

dependencies.rationale: The always-loaded instruction must point to a proven installed route rather than an aspirational command.

acceptance.criterion: A fresh agent can discover one command and correctly route policy, skill, instruction, tool, project, or general feedback without inspecting implementation files.
acceptance.negative_control: No generic feedback boilerplate is added to active shared SKILL.md files.

acceptance.criterion: Policy, skill, and general test entries record, list, report, and disposition end to end, and the observed planning-profile mismatch is preserved as real friction evidence.
acceptance.negative_control: The real record names evidence and the failure family rather than only the one failed command.
